subject.title: fix(feishu): bound stalled docx image URL reads

question: Should the selected Feishu account HTTP timeout intentionally govern both the complete external docx image download and body-idle gaps?
rationale: Source and proof establish that the patch works, but repository history distinguishes API-request and media-transfer timing; only maintainers can confirm whether expanding this setting’s operational meaning is the desired compatibility policy.

options.title: Accept scoped timeout reuse
options.body: Merge with the existing account timeout governing both total docx image fetch duration and idle-body gaps.

options.title: Separate media timing policy
options.body: Use a distinct media transfer deadline while retaining an idle-body bound if progressing image downloads should outlive ordinary API requests.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped timeout reuse
recommendation.body: Merge with the existing account timeout governing both total docx image fetch duration and idle-body gaps.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the relevant Feishu configurable timeout and media-transfer exception behavior.
